- Maximum age: 58 years at loan application or 60 years at the scheduled loan maturity date, whichever is earlier [1].

answers.question: What extra benefit do senior citizens get on FDs, and what is the TDS threshold for them?
answers.answer:
Senior citizens (aged 60 and above) receive an extra 0.50% p.a. interest rate advantage on all fixed deposit tenures compared to regular customers. For example, on a 1-year FD, the regular rate is 7.50% p.a., while senior citizens earn 8.00% p.a. This additional 0.50% p.a. applies across all deposit tenures offered by FinBase [1][2].

Regarding TDS (Tax Deducted at Source), the threshold for senior citizens is ₹50,000 of total annual interest income across all deposits in a financial year. If the interest income exceeds this amount, TDS is deducted at 10%. For non-PAN linked accounts, TDS is deducted at 20%. Senior citizens can submit Form 15H digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS if their estimated total income is below the taxable threshold [3].

You can contact FinBase support or apply through their platform to get a formal decision based on your complete profile.

answers.question: What UPI services do you provide?
answers.answer:
FinBase provides both peer-to-peer (P2P) and merchant (P2M) UPI transactions with no fees charged for these services [1]. The UPI transactions are routed through the NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 5 and are auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0009 [1]. Verification uses the NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key, and disputes are resolved within 48 business hours [1].

The standard daily UPI limit is up to ₹1,00,000 per calendar day for P2P transfers, with a maximum of 20 outbound UPI payments allowed per rolling 24-hour window [2][3]. There is a first 24-hour cooling period security restriction when a customer links a new bank account or resets their UPI PIN, limiting outward UPI payments to ₹5,000 during this period; the full ₹1,00,000 daily limit unlocks exactly 24 hours after PIN registration [3].

Additionally, UPI transfers are free with a daily cumulative limit of ₹1,00,000 and a maximum of 20 outbound transactions per rolling 24-hour window [2].

In summary, FinBase offers free P2P and P2M UPI transactions with daily and frequency limits, security cooling periods for new PINs or linked accounts, and automated reconciliation and dispute resolution processes [1][2][3].
